referenceFidelity.findings: Compared supplied close and wide office photographs to current front, left, oblique and phone exports. Tall warm oak end-cap has dense varied book rows, a clear sculptural display shelf and separate full circular wood disk with a warm halo. Side reading portal has rounded rectangular corners, an actual recessed cushion, diamond upholstery and black lamp. Human occupant and literal book titles are intentionally omitted.

construction.findings: Closed ring geometry forms a true -X side opening; padded ring sits within the oak frame. Cabinet book stack remains on +Z and ends before the shifted side portal. Reading seat is physically recessed with a fitted structural and quilted back. Bust clears the shelf above, full circular halo clears roof and book tops. Front/left/close and blank rear export show supported panels and coherent shelf depth.

readability.findings: At 390px the rounded opening, diamond lining and hanging lamp remain distinct; front view identifies the bookcase and halo. Default positive-X oblique faces the closed side, so the left side and a left oblique were also examined. Book labels remain intentionally secondary.

motion.findings: Static environment furniture. No animation, rig, moving root or gameplay behavior requested.

secondPass.findings: Initial export exposed upper books overlapping the halo and a shelf clipping the bust. Removed the surplus upper row, lowered/reduced halo and shortened bust. Shifted side opening behind front shelving, tightened quilting seam spacing and fitted a shallower seat back. Re-exported and independently rechecked current front/left/reverse/oblique/close and 390px renders against both supplied photos; halo is fully visible, niche is genuine and shelving has clear structural separation.
